claims: The 2026 NCAA Tournament Selection Sunday is Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The Men's bracket reveal is at 6 p.m. ET on CBS and Paramount+.
The Women's bracket reveal is at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN.
The Men's Selection Show is at 6:00 p.m. ET on Sunday, March 15, 2026, on CBS/Paramount+.
The Women's Selection Show is at 8:00 p.m. ET on Sunday, March 15, 2026, on ESPN.
The Men's Selection Show and the Women's Selection Show will feature the unveiling of the full 68-team fields.
The Men's Selection Show and the Women's Selection Show will feature the unveiling of bracket matchups.
The Men's Selection Show and the Women's Selection Show are available for streaming on March Madness Live.
The First Four games begin on March 17-18, 2026.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament runs through April 6, 2026.
